query: Official template workflow 3d_hunyuan3d-v2.1 (and other 3D templates) cannot start after updating ComfyUI: 'Cannot execute because a node is missing the class_type property.: Node ID #1'. The template requires the third-party ComfyUI-Hunyuan3d-2-1 custom node which is not installed.

desired.outcome: Missing custom node: maintainer pointed to https://github.com/visualbruno/ComfyUI-Hunyuan3d-2-1 ; Comfy team also shipped improved error messaging in frontend v1.39.5 that names the missing node type.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; proposed fix is actionable and directionally correct.
